dialog.first_run.title: First run
dialog.first_run.text:
linuxEsword needs to locate your e-Sword modules folder.

Select the folder containing the .bblx, .cmtx, .dctx, .lexi files, etc. No file will be modified.
dialog.about.title: About linuxEsword
dialog.about.text:
linuxEsword {version}

Native e-Sword module reader for Linux.

Reads e-Sword SQLite modules directly, without Wine. SQLitePlus-encrypted modules are decrypted with Twofish-128.

License: GPL-3.0 (the Twofish decryptor derives from KingJamesPureBibleSearch, © Donna Whisnant).
